keyDates.text: U.S. Midterm Election Day - Congressional control of House and Senate decided; higher ed funding, research oversight, and student aid policy hang in the balance
Treasury comment deadline closes on proposed rule governing tax-exemption standards, DEI conditions, and grant compliance for private institutions
Financial aid price-fixing antitrust trial (Henry v. Brown) scheduled to begin in Chicago; Cornell, Penn, MIT, Georgetown, and Notre Dame are defendants
Chronicle of Higher Education hosts post-election higher ed readout webinar for sector leaders
Princeton Schmidt Transformative Technology Fund proposals due - awards up to $500,000 per project
Early Decision and Early Action decisions released to Class of 2027 applicants across Ivy League and most selective institutions
Regular Decision application deadlines open across Common App member institutions for Class of 2027
ED Accreditation overhaul final rule takes effect - accreditors must embed academic freedom and intellectual diversity standards or risk loss of federal recognition
